strict-audit.json.reason: Legacy Object.hasOwn converted array partId/color to a string key. Strict primitive-type validation now rejects it.
strict-audit.json.scope: Historical metrics rechecked without overwriting source runs. Invalid-response issue wording can differ.

mutation-audit.json.scope: All v2 objects: plan omissions/duplicates/unknown IDs/reversal; edit no-op; repair false localization; structure ID/yaw/order invariance and duplicate IDs.

independent-audit.json.independentGeometryMethod: unordered cell maps and face intersections
independent-audit.json.scope: All source objects: ID/yaw symmetry, piece deletion, recolor. Does not prove all arbitrary malformed inputs or physical mechanics.

exact-near-duplicates.json.method: Lossless length/prefix-filtered exact Jaccard join of colorless canonical part-position sets.
limitations: Canonical orientation may change after a perturbation; not a best-aligned geometric near-duplicate metric.
No semantic or subassembly containment guarantee; no statement about external pretraining overlap.

connector-audit.json.scope: Nominal grid stud-hole positions for supported catalog only; not general hinges/axles/balls or forces.
connector-audit.json.upstream: BrickNet bundled MIT annotations, original attribution retained.

render-verification.json.scope: Same pinned renderer/browser on this machine; not cross-GPU raster identity.

backend-corpus-check.json.scope: Preprocessing equality only; kernel precision can change decoding.

merge-verification.json.scope: Independent CPU delta matrix reconstruction with MPS cast-before-add semantics; bfloat16 rounding tolerance, not identical logits across backends.

training-token-audit.json.scope: Train/validation oracle serialization lengths, not a lower bound for all correct equivalent answers. No inference performed.

test-token-audit.json.scope: SmolVLM compact oracle serialization only; no test answer passed to inference. Other tokenizers and equivalent answers can have different lengths.
